landingModesLead.message: From a precise element to the full page, from manual scroll to batch packaging — six modes that map one-to-one to the extension; pick by scenario.

landingModeRegionDesc.message: Click any element; it auto-uses the nearest scrollable ancestor and captures all the way to the bottom.

landingModeFullPageDesc.message: Auto-scrolls the whole page and stitches it, waiting out lazy-loading where possible.

landingModeCustomDesc.message: After choosing a scroll region, browse manually; frames are sampled by actual scroll distance, deduped, and stitched.

landingModeElementDesc.message: Captures exactly the clicked DOM element — it never promotes up to its scrollable parent.

landingModeFocusDesc.message: Temporarily expands the target ancestor and hides unrelated branches, keeping only the target content for a tall shot.

landingModeAllDesc.message: Finds every scrollable element on the page, captures each, and packages them into a ZIP download.

landingHowHeadline.message: Three steps: from opening the icon to getting the shot.

landingHowLead.message: Zero learning curve: pick a mode, click a target — the scrolling, cropping, and stitching all happen locally, automatically.

landingStep1Desc.message: Click the toolbar icon, choose a capture mode, and adjust high-DPI, delay, and other settings as needed.

landingStep1Meta.message: Triggered by icon click · activeTab grant

landingStep2Desc.message: Click the element to capture; in custom mode, use ↑↓ to reach the right level.

landingStep2Meta.message: Picker highlights the current element · shows selector

landingStep3Desc.message: Auto-scroll · capture viewport · stitch by rectangle → download PNG or preview first.

landingStep3Meta.message: In-memory local processing · writes straight to your downloads

landingPrivacyLead.message: No collecting, storing, or uploading of any page content or screenshot. Every pixel is handled in your machine's memory, then saved to your downloads folder.

landingPfactPermsDesc.message: No blanket host permissions — that's the one thing it does: after you click the icon, capture the visible elements on the current tab.

landingPfactClickTitle.message: Authorized only on icon click — no standing host access

landingPfactClickDesc.message: Authorization happens the moment you trigger it. It never reads any site in the background, and there's no silently-running background script.

landingPfactNetDesc.message: Screenshot pixels never leave your machine: scrolling, cropping, and stitching all happen in memory, and the result lands only in your chosen downloads folder.

landingTuneHeadline.message: Get the page looking exactly how you want it before capturing.

landingTuneLead.message: After picking a target, edit text right on the page or click away distracting elements one by one — every change applies only to this capture, and the page is restored afterwards.

landingEditDesc.message: Make the target editable and fix typos, sensitive details, or placeholder text; capture the edited content, and choose via settings whether to keep the original restored.

landingHideDesc.message: Click any distracting element — ads, nav, popups — to mark it; those elements are removed entirely from the final image, then restored when the capture ends.

landingCtaSub.message: Region, full-page, custom, all-scrollable-elements — four modes, installed once.

landingCtaNote.message: Install link available once listed on the Chrome Web Store

regionDetailIntro.message: Region capture takes whichever element you click and uses its nearest scrollable ancestor — scrolling it top to bottom and stitching every visible frame into one tall image. It reads the final rendered rect, so transforms, flex, and overflow:hidden do not throw it off.

regionDetailBestFor.message: A scrollable card, list, or panel you want captured whole.

elementDetailIntro.message: Element capture keeps the exact DOM node you clicked. It scrolls the nearest scrollable parent and clips strictly to that node box, so you get precisely that element — never its larger scroll container.

elementDetailBestFor.message: One specific row, cell, badge, or widget, exactly as rendered.

focusDetailIntro.message: Focus capture temporarily expands the target’s ancestor chain with CSS and hides unrelated branches, so a tall target trapped under overflow:hidden or fixed-height ancestors can be captured whole — then every change is undone.

focusDetailBestFor.message: A target buried under constraining ancestors you don’t want to fight by hand.

fullPageDetailIntro.message: Full-page capture auto-scrolls the whole page and stitches every viewport into one long image, pausing for lazy-loaded content where it can. It picks the document root, or the first scrollable descendant when the root can’t scroll.

fullPageDetailBestFor.message: Saving an entire article or page top to bottom.

customDetailIntro.message: Manual scroll capture records an initial frame, then you browse the content yourself. Each time scrolling settles, a frame is appended; press any key to finish. Frames are de-duplicated and stitched by actual scroll distance.

customDetailBestFor.message: Content you want to read and capture frame by frame, or that loads on demand.

customDetailTitle.message: Manual scroll capture · demo · Screenshot Suite

allScrollableDetailIntro.message: All-scrollable capture finds every scrollable element on the page, highlights them all, and lets you toggle any off. Confirm to capture the remaining set one by one and download them as a ZIP.

allScrollableDetailBestFor.message: Grabbing every scrollable panel on a page in a single pass.

allScrollableDetailTitle.message: All scrollable elements · demo · Screenshot Suite
